You've stopped believing that you have relevance in the world. When you say, "I want to cure my cancer; I want to cure my cancer," what you're really saying is, "I want to find a new faith; I want to believe in myself again; I want to reestablish my relevance in the world." So, you have the desire. Once you have the desire, then the cure makes sense.

Another way of saying this is: If you don't feel well and your parents make you go see a psychiatrist, you probably won't feel better. But if you yourself want to get better and you go see a psychiatrist, you'll probably get better. So why this person improved his or her cancer is because of faith. She won't get better on her own.

If you're able to orientate your mind in a certain way, you're capable of tremendous miracles. Another idea is meditation: If you're able to control your thoughts and calm yourself down, your body will heal a lot faster.
